Backend Engineer | RetailFlow Technologies  
Scaling e-commerce platforms with scalable, resilient systems.  

Driven by solving complex problems, I design and deploy backend solutions that power high-traffic retail experiences. Over the past two years, I’ve architected microservices architectures on AWS, optimizing performance for millions of transactions daily. My work with Docker ensures seamless containerization, while PostgreSQL handles critical data operations with precision.  

Adept at crafting REST APIs that balance security and efficiency, I’ve streamlined integrations across distributed systems. Linux administration skills keep infrastructure running smoothly, and monitoring tools ensure real-time visibility into system health.  

Collaborating with cross-functional teams, I turn business needs into technical roadmaps. Whether refining database queries or automating CI/CD pipelines, I focus on reliability and scalability.  

Looking ahead, I’m excited to leverage my expertise in Python and cloud-native tools to drive innovation in retail tech. Let’s connect and explore how we can build smarter, faster systems together.
